title: Community embeddings join the model catalog
summary:
Community embeddings gained an endpoint, Floret learned more audio and video work, and a story-making app joined the catalog.

Community publishers can register and test OpenAI-compatible embedding models through My Models, the Account API, and the polli CLI. Registered models appear in model listings and accept text inputs through `/v1/embeddings`, with optional dimensions and float or base64 output.

Floret now discovers models by their catalogued capabilities, can delegate text generation to models without tool calling, and adds audio generation, transcription, voice changing, and voice isolation. Video generation uses catalogued duration defaults and end frames when available; streaming tool progress now arrives as structured tool-call deltas.

AI Story & Image Studio was added to the image app catalog. The README was also refreshed with a clearer explanation of canonical model slugs and updated star-history charts.

daily.title: Publish community embedding models
daily.text: Register and test OpenAI-compatible embedding models in My Models or the polli CLI. They appear in model listings and accept text through `/v1/embeddings`, with optional dimensions and float or base64 output. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: More audio tools for Floret
daily.text: Floret can now generate and transcribe audio, change voices, and isolate voices. Audio generation also accepts duration and seed.

daily.title: Floret follows model capabilities
daily.text: Floret now discovers text, image, video, and audio models from the catalog, including text models that cannot call tools. Its video tools use available duration defaults and end-frame support.
